_comment: 'expected' is the route QueryEngine._route should choose:
cembrowski - answer from the unfiltered Qdrant corpus (posters + the Cembrowski & Carey textbook)
site       - answer from kind IN (site, document) -- BAPa/site/tool/team questions
nih        - answer from MedlinePlus/PubMed (a member of the public asking about themselves)
general    - open-domain, no retrieval (math, geography, current events, contested topics)
hostile    - a short civil non-defensive reply, no retrieval
author     - a fuzzy hit on a name known to the corpus, answered from that person's bio + works
'group' only affects reporting. The poster questions are written against the
17 poster titles actually present in the BAPa-V2 collection, so if a poster is
re-ingested under a different title its question should start failing -- that is
the point. The consumer questions deliberately name analytes the corpus also
covers (ferritin, platelets, potassium, A1c) because that overlap is exactly
where the laboratory-vs-patient line gets tested.
